data.acquisitionSummary: Current Singtel registration guidance reconfirms a 30-day validity cap for passport registration. Passport self-registration grants data-only features; retaining the SIM beyond 30 days requires re-registration with Singpass or an original Singapore-issued ID/work pass through supported Singtel channels.

keep.action: BLOCKED for passport-only overseas retention: passport registration is capped at 30 days, and retention beyond that requires Singpass or a Singapore-issued ID/work pass. Passport self-registration only grants data-only features.

data.chinaActivation: Passport self-registration can activate data-only features, but it does not provide a durable voice/SMS route and remains subject to the 30-day passport cap.
data.kyc: IMDA-mandated registration; passport registration = 30-day cap and data-only self-registration. Durable retention requires Singpass or an original Singapore-issued ID/work pass.
data.roamingSms: Not a viable passport-self-registration OTP/SMS route: current Singtel guidance limits passport self-registration to data-only features.
data.holdReason: Passport-only users face a 30-day registration cap; current self-registration with passport is data-only, and durable retention requires Singpass or a Singapore-issued ID/work pass. Keep as negative knowledge, not a recommendation.
data.tariffSummary: Passport registration: 30-day cap; passport self-registration is data-only; durable retention requires Singapore credentials.
guideSteps: Do not recommend this route for passport-only overseas number retention; use it as an avoid-route warning.
